findings.evidence: All candidates consume only 10 features from STAMP hourly OHLCV; orderbook, DEX liquidity, BTC/ETH, holders and news are collected but not model inputs.
All three production estimators default to squared error; approval evaluates absolute error.
The best of three is selected on the same forward scores reported for eligibility; prospective approval remains separately gated.
Each cycle refits matured OHLCV labels. Journal forecast errors are used for approval, not model features, weights or model selection.
Three models are fitted once per block; live research refits after every completed hourly candle.

limitation: Exploratory diagnosis of a single pair and snapshot. No model is changed or approved; neither repeated backtests nor the later holdout are prospective proof.
